sections.advice: Treat High point near Limours → Garches as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch in Conflans-Sainte-Honorine → Photo stop near Parmain is the reward section in Paris. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.advice: Photo stop near Parmain → Near Quincy-Voisins, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

sections.advice: Food stop near Neufmoutiers-en-Brie → Back to Perche Quiet is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
